cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Inventory Analyst who understands inventory and ensures that the right parts are available. This role sits within our Distribution and Manufacturing plant and reports to the Operations Manager.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Lead the cycle count process for the manufacturing facility and ensure standard methodologies are shared across the organization.
Connect with IT and Finance to coordinate cycle counts and physical inventory, as required.
Conduct inventory analysis by facility and value stream for all PH levels in SAP.
Work closely with the manufacturing facility to ensure fix bin integrity optimization.
Troubleshoot inventory discrepancies with regard to bin integrity and material BOM backflushing.
Minimize and correct facility recorded COGI errors through the manufacturing process.
Be the process owner for Sarbanes-Oxley process documentation and mapping as it relates to inventory control.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or related discipline; equivalent years of experience may be considered in lieu of education
Three (3) years of inventory control experience, including materials planning and procurement in a plant environment
Proven success in inventory troubleshooting to optimize accuracy
Effective communication and negotiation skills
Legal authorization to work in [Location masked] — sponsorship will not be provided for this position
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or related discipline
Experience implementing or using SAP
Experience in warehouse distribution and working with a global supply chain
C.P.M. And/or C.P.I.M. Certifications
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Lead the cycle count process for the manufacturing facility and ensure standard methodologies are shared across the organization.
Direct coordination with IT and Finance to execute cycle counts and physical inventory, as required.
Conduct inventory analysis by facility and value stream for all PH levels in SAP.
Drive fix bin integrity optimization in close coordination with the manufacturing facility.
Own troubleshooting of inventory discrepancies related to bin integrity and material BOM backflushing.
Identify and correct facility recorded COGI errors through the manufacturing process.
Take ownership of Sarbanes-Oxley process documentation and mapping as it relates to inventory control.
cond_0476.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or related discipline; equivalent years of experience may be considered in lieu of education
Three (3) years of inventory control experience, including materials planning and procurement in a plant environment
Proven success in inventory troubleshooting to optimize accuracy
Effective communication and negotiation skills
Legal authorization to work in [Location masked] — sponsorship will not be provided for this position
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or related discipline
Experience implementing or using SAP
Experience in warehouse distribution and working with a global supply chain
C.P.M. And/or C.P.I.M. Certifications

Effective communication and negotiation skills
Legal authorization to work in [Location masked] - Sponsorship will not be provided for this position
